# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.
- **Customizable Interviewer Personas**: Choose the personality of your AI interviewer—from a friendly recruiter to a stern technical lead—to simulate different types of interview environments.
- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive constructive, turn-by-turn feedback on your responses during the interview.
- **Comprehensive Performance Report**: After the interview, receive a detailed report summarizing your strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable advice.
- **Suggested Learning Resources**: Get a curated list of articles and resources based on your performance to help you study effectively.
- **Practice Mode**: Warm up without the pressure of a final report. Just focus on the conversation.
- **Video Recording**: Opt-in to record your session to review your body language and delivery later.

## Database Setup (Required)

To use the profile and history features, you must set up the database tables in your Supabase project.

1.  Open your project in the **Supabase Dashboard**.
2.  Go to the **SQL Editor** (icon on the left sidebar).
3.  Click **New query**.
4.  Copy the contents of the `supabase/schema.sql` file in this repository.
5.  Paste the SQL into the editor and click **Run**.

This will create the necessary `profiles` and `interviews` tables with the correct permissions.

## How It Works

1.  **Enter Your Email**: Provide your email to receive your final report.
2.  **Configure Your Interview**: Select the domain (e.g., Software Engineering), the experience level (e.g., Senior), and the interviewer's persona you want to practice for.
3.  **Start the Interview**: Grant camera and microphone permissions and begin the conversation. The AI will introduce itself and ask the first question.
4.  **Receive Your Report**: Once you end the interview, a detailed performance analysis and learning resources will be generated and sent to your email.

---

Built with passion by DevJs to help you land your dream job.

-- WARNING: This schema is for context only and is not meant to be run.
-- Table order and constraints may not be valid for execution.

CREATE TABLE public.feedback (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  interview_id uuid NOT NULL,
  user_text text NOT NULL,
  feedback_text text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT feedback_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT feedback_interview_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (interview_id) REFERENCES public.interviews(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.interview_reports (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  interview_id uuid NOT NULL,
  overall_summary text NOT NULL,
  key_strengths ARRAY NOT NULL,
  areas_for_improvement ARRAY NOT NULL,
  actionable_advice ARRAY NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT interview_reports_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT interview_reports_interview_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (interview_id) REFERENCES public.interviews(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.interviews (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid,
  name text NOT NULL,
  description text,
  system_instruction text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT interviews_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT interviews_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.skill_ratings (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  report_id uuid NOT NULL,
  skill_name text NOT NULL,
  rating integer NOT NULL CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 10),
  justification text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT skill_ratings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT skill_ratings_report_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (report_id) REFERENCES public.interview_reports(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.suggested_resources (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  interview_id uuid NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  uri text NOT NULL,
  fetched_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT suggested_resources_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT suggested_resources_interview_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (interview_id) REFERENCES public.interviews(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.transcriptions (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  interview_id uuid NOT NULL,
  speaker text NOT NULL CHECK (speaker = ANY (ARRAY['user'::text, 'ai'::text])),
  text text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT transcriptions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT transcriptions_interview_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (interview_id) REFERENCES public.interviews(id)
);

# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.

- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.

  pronouns text,

alter table profiles enable row level security;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS interviews;

);

create policy "Users can insert their own interviews."
  on interviews for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = user_id );
```

# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.
- **Customizable Interviewer Personas**: Choose the personality of your AI interviewer—from a friendly recruiter to a stern technical lead—to simulate different types of interview environments.
- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive constructive, turn-by-turn feedback on your responses during the interview.
- **Comprehensive Performance Report**: After the interview, receive a detailed report summarizing your strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable advice.
- **Suggested Learning Resources**: Get a curated list of articles and resources based on your performance to help you study effectively.
- **Practice Mode**: Warm up without the pressure of a final report. Just focus on the conversation.
- **Video Recording**: Opt-in to record your session to review your body language and delivery later.
- **CV Builder & Motivation Letter**: Create professional documents and save them to your profile.

## Database Setup (Required)

To use the profile, history, and document saving features, you must set up the database tables in your Supabase project.

1.  Open your project in the **Supabase Dashboard**.
2.  Go to the **SQL Editor** (icon on the left sidebar).
3.  Click **New query**.
4.  Copy the SQL script below:

```sql
-- Create a table for public profiles
create table profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users not null primary key,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone,
  full_name text,
  pronouns text,
  avatar_url text,

  constraint full_name_length check (char_length(full_name) >= 3)
);

-- Set up Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table profiles enable row level security;

create policy "Public profiles are viewable by everyone."
  on profiles for select
  using ( true );

create policy "Users can insert their own profile."
  on profiles for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = id );

create policy "Users can update own profile."
  on profiles for update
  using ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Create a table for interviews
create table interviews (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  transcription jsonb not null,
  feedback jsonb not null,
  report jsonb,
  resources jsonb
);

-- Set up RLS for interviews
alter table interviews enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own interviews."
  on interviews for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert their own interviews."
  on interviews for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved CVs
create table cvs (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  content text not null, -- HTML content
  data jsonb -- Raw input data for future editing
);

alter table cvs enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own CVs."
  on cvs for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own CVs."
  on cvs for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved Motivation Letters
create table motivation_letters (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  job_title text,
  company text,
  content text not null
);

alter table motivation_letters enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- STORAGE SETUP
-- You must create a new public bucket named 'avatars' in the Storage section of Supabase
-- Policy for avatars bucket:
-- ALLOW 'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE' for authenticated users.
```

5.  Paste the SQL into the editor and click **Run**.

## Troubleshooting

### Database Error: "column interviews.config does not exist"
If you see this error, your `interviews` table is missing the required `config` column. This often happens if the table was created with an older version of the schema.

To fix this, you can drop the existing table and recreate it. **Warning: This will delete existing interview history.**

```sql
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS interviews;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS profiles;
-- Then run the CREATE TABLE scripts from above.
```

## How It Works

1.  **Enter Your Email**: Provide your email to receive your final report.
2.  **Configure Your Interview**: Select the domain (e.g., Software Engineering), the experience level (e.g., Senior), and the interviewer's persona you want to practice for.
3.  **Start the Interview**: Grant camera and microphone permissions and begin the conversation. The AI will introduce itself and ask the first question.
4.  **Receive Your Report**: Once you end the interview, a detailed performance analysis and learning resources will be generated and sent to your email.

---

Built with passion by DevJs to help you land your dream job.

# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.
- **Customizable Interviewer Personas**: Choose the personality of your AI interviewer—from a friendly recruiter to a stern technical lead—to simulate different types of interview environments.
- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive constructive, turn-by-turn feedback on your responses during the interview.
- **Comprehensive Performance Report**: After the interview, receive a detailed report summarizing your strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable advice.
- **Suggested Learning Resources**: Get a curated list of articles and resources based on your performance to help you study effectively.
- **Practice Mode**: Warm up without the pressure of a final report. Just focus on the conversation.
- **Video Recording**: Opt-in to record your session to review your body language and delivery later.
- **CV Builder & Motivation Letter**: Create professional documents and save them to your profile.

## Database Setup (Required)

To use the profile, history, and document saving features, you must set up the database tables in your Supabase project.

1.  Open your project in the **Supabase Dashboard**.
2.  Go to the **SQL Editor** (icon on the left sidebar).
3.  Click **New query**.
4.  Copy the SQL script below:

```sql
-- Create a table for public profiles
create table profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users not null primary key,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone,
  full_name text,
  pronouns text,
  avatar_url text,

  constraint full_name_length check (char_length(full_name) >= 3)
);

-- Set up Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table profiles enable row level security;

create policy "Public profiles are viewable by everyone."
  on profiles for select
  using ( true );

create policy "Users can insert their own profile."
  on profiles for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = id );

create policy "Users can update own profile."
  on profiles for update
  using ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Create a table for interviews
create table interviews (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  transcription jsonb not null,
  feedback jsonb not null,
  report jsonb,
  resources jsonb
);

-- Set up RLS for interviews
alter table interviews enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own interviews."
  on interviews for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert their own interviews."
  on interviews for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved CVs
create table cvs (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  content text not null, -- HTML content
  data jsonb -- Raw input data for future editing
);

alter table cvs enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own CVs."
  on cvs for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own CVs."
  on cvs for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved Motivation Letters
create table motivation_letters (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  job_title text,
  company text,
  content text not null
);

alter table motivation_letters enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- STORAGE SETUP
-- You must create a new public bucket named 'avatars' in the Storage section of Supabase
-- Policy for avatars bucket:
-- ALLOW 'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE' for authenticated users.
```

5.  Paste the SQL into the editor and click **Run**.

## Troubleshooting

### Database Error: "column profiles.avatar_url does not exist"
If you see this error, you likely created the `profiles` table before the avatar feature was added. To fix this without losing data, run this SQL command in your Supabase SQL Editor:

```sql
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS avatar_url text;
```

### Database Error: "column interviews.config does not exist"
To fix this, you can drop the existing table and recreate it. **Warning: This will delete existing interview history.**

```sql
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS interviews;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS profiles;
-- Then run the CREATE TABLE scripts from above.
```

## How It Works

1.  **Enter Your Email**: Provide your email to receive your final report.
2.  **Configure Your Interview**: Select the domain (e.g., Software Engineering), the experience level (e.g., Senior), and the interviewer's persona you want to practice for.
3.  **Start the Interview**: Grant camera and microphone permissions and begin the conversation. The AI will introduce itself and ask the first question.
4.  **Receive Your Report**: Once you end the interview, a detailed performance analysis and learning resources will be generated and sent to your email.

---

Built with passion by DevJs to help you land your dream job.

-- Allow public access to view avatars

# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.
- **Customizable Interviewer Personas**: Choose the personality of your AI interviewer—from a friendly recruiter to a stern technical lead—to simulate different types of interview environments.
- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive constructive, turn-by-turn feedback on your responses during the interview.
- **Comprehensive Performance Report**: After the interview, receive a detailed report summarizing your strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable advice.
- **Suggested Learning Resources**: Get a curated list of articles and resources based on your performance to help you study effectively.
- **Practice Mode**: Warm up without the pressure of a final report. Just focus on the conversation.
- **Video Recording**: Opt-in to record your session to review your body language and delivery later.
- **CV Builder & Motivation Letter**: Create professional documents and save them to your profile.

## Database Setup (Required)

To use the profile, history, and document saving features, you must set up the database tables in your Supabase project.

1.  Open your project in the **Supabase Dashboard**.
2.  Go to the **SQL Editor** (icon on the left sidebar).
3.  Click **New query**.
4.  Copy the SQL script below:

```sql
-- Create a table for public profiles
create table profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users not null primary key,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone,
  full_name text,
  pronouns text,
  avatar_url text,

  constraint full_name_length check (char_length(full_name) >= 3)
);

-- Set up Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table profiles enable row level security;

create policy "Public profiles are viewable by everyone."
  on profiles for select
  using ( true );

create policy "Users can insert their own profile."
  on profiles for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = id );

create policy "Users can update own profile."
  on profiles for update
  using ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Create a table for interviews
create table interviews (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  transcription jsonb not null,
  feedback jsonb not null,
  report jsonb,
  resources jsonb
);

-- Set up RLS for interviews
alter table interviews enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own interviews."
  on interviews for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert their own interviews."
  on interviews for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved CVs
create table cvs (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  content text not null, -- HTML content
  data jsonb -- Raw input data for future editing
);

alter table cvs enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own CVs."
  on cvs for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own CVs."
  on cvs for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved Motivation Letters
create table motivation_letters (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  job_title text,
  company text,
  content text not null
);

alter table motivation_letters enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- STORAGE SETUP
-- Run this to create the 'avatars' bucket and policies
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
values ('avatars', 'avatars', true)
on conflict (id) do nothing;

create policy "Avatar images are publicly accessible."
  on storage.objects for select
  using ( bucket_id = 'avatars' );

create policy "Authenticated users can upload avatars."
  on storage.objects for insert
  with check ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.role() = 'authenticated' );

create policy "Users can update their own avatars."
  on storage.objects for update
  using ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.uid() = owner )
  with check ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.uid() = owner );
```

5.  Paste the SQL into the editor and click **Run**.

## Troubleshooting

### Database Error: "column profiles.avatar_url does not exist"
If you see this error, you likely created the `profiles` table before the avatar feature was added. To fix this without losing data, run this SQL command in your Supabase SQL Editor:

```sql
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS avatar_url text;
```

### Storage Error: "Bucket not found"
If you see this error when uploading a photo, it means the storage bucket wasn't created. Run the **STORAGE SETUP** SQL block above in your Supabase SQL Editor.

### Database Error: "column interviews.config does not exist"
To fix this, you can drop the existing table and recreate it. **Warning: This will delete existing interview history.**

```sql
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS interviews;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS profiles;
-- Then run the CREATE TABLE scripts from above.
```

## How It Works

1.  **Enter Your Email**: Provide your email to receive your final report.
2.  **Configure Your Interview**: Select the domain (e.g., Software Engineering), the experience level (e.g., Senior), and the interviewer's persona you want to practice for.
3.  **Start the Interview**: Grant camera and microphone permissions and begin the conversation. The AI will introduce itself and ask the first question.
4.  **Receive Your Report**: Once you end the interview, a detailed performance analysis and learning resources will be generated and sent to your email.

---

Built with passion by DevJs to help you land your dream job.

# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.
- **Customizable Interviewer Personas**: Choose the personality of your AI interviewer—from a friendly recruiter to a stern technical lead—to simulate different types of interview environments.
- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive constructive, turn-by-turn feedback on your responses during the interview.
- **Comprehensive Performance Report**: After the interview, receive a detailed report summarizing your strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable advice.
- **Suggested Learning Resources**: Get a curated list of articles and resources based on your performance to help you study effectively.
- **Practice Mode**: Warm up without the pressure of a final report. Just focus on the conversation.
- **Video Recording**: Opt-in to record your session to review your body language and delivery later.
- **CV Builder & Motivation Letter**: Create professional documents and save them to your profile.
- **Portfolio Builder**: Generate a professional single-page portfolio website using AI.

## Database Setup (Required)

To use the profile, history, and document saving features, you must set up the database tables in your Supabase project.

1.  Open your project in the **Supabase Dashboard**.
2.  Go to the **SQL Editor** (icon on the left sidebar).
3.  Click **New query**.
4.  Copy the SQL script below:

```sql
-- Create a table for public profiles
create table profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users not null primary key,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone,
  full_name text,
  pronouns text,
  avatar_url text,

  constraint full_name_length check (char_length(full_name) >= 3)
);

-- Set up Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table profiles enable row level security;

create policy "Public profiles are viewable by everyone."
  on profiles for select
  using ( true );

create policy "Users can insert their own profile."
  on profiles for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = id );

create policy "Users can update own profile."
  on profiles for update
  using ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Create a table for interviews
create table interviews (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  transcription jsonb not null,
  feedback jsonb not null,
  report jsonb,
  resources jsonb
);

-- Set up RLS for interviews
alter table interviews enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own interviews."
  on interviews for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert their own interviews."
  on interviews for insert

  on cvs for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

);

);

insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
values ('avatars', 'avatars', true)

## Troubleshooting

### Database Error: "column profiles.avatar_url does not exist"
If you see this error, you likely created the `profiles` table before the avatar feature was added. To fix this without losing data, run this SQL command in your Supabase SQL Editor:

```sql
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS avatar_url text;
```

### Storage Error: "Bucket not found"
If you see this error when uploading a photo, it means the storage bucket wasn't created. Run the **STORAGE SETUP** SQL block above in your Supabase SQL Editor.

### Database Error: "column interviews.config does not exist"
To fix this, you can drop the existing table and recreate it. **Warning: This will delete existing interview history.**

```sql
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS interviews;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS profiles;
-- Then run the CREATE TABLE scripts from above.
```

# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.
- **Customizable Interviewer Personas**: Choose the personality of your AI interviewer—from a friendly recruiter to a stern technical lead—to simulate different types of interview environments.
- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive constructive, turn-by-turn feedback on your responses during the interview.
- **Comprehensive Performance Report**: After the interview, receive a detailed report summarizing your strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable advice.
- **Suggested Learning Resources**: Get a curated list of articles and resources based on your performance to help you study effectively.
- **Practice Mode**: Warm up without the pressure of a final report. Just focus on the conversation.
- **Video Recording**: Opt-in to record your session to review your body language and delivery later.
- **CV Builder & Motivation Letter**: Create professional documents and save them to your profile.
- **Portfolio Builder**: Generate a professional single-page portfolio website using AI.
- **Admin Dashboard**: A secure panel for administrators to view system statistics and user activity.

## Database Setup (Required)

To use the profile, history, document saving, and admin features, you must set up the database tables in your Supabase project.

1.  Open your project in the **Supabase Dashboard**.
2.  Go to the **SQL Editor** (icon on the left sidebar).
3.  Click **New query**.
4.  Copy the SQL script below:

```sql
-- Create a table for public profiles
create table if not exists profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users not null primary key,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone,
  full_name text,
  pronouns text,
  avatar_url text,
  is_admin boolean default false,

  constraint full_name_length check (char_length(full_name) >= 3)
);

-- Set up Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table profiles enable row level security;

create policy "Public profiles are viewable by everyone."
  on profiles for select
  using ( true );

create policy "Users can insert their own profile."
  on profiles for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = id );

create policy "Users can update own profile."
  on profiles for update
  using ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Create a table for interviews
create table if not exists interviews (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  transcription jsonb not null,
  feedback jsonb not null,
  report jsonb,
  resources jsonb
);

-- Set up RLS for interviews
alter table interviews enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own interviews."
  on interviews for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert their own interviews."
  on interviews for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved CVs
create table if not exists cvs (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  content text not null, -- HTML content
  data jsonb -- Raw input data for future editing
);

alter table cvs enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own CVs."
  on cvs for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own CVs."
  on cvs for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved Motivation Letters
create table if not exists motivation_letters (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  job_title text,
  company text,
  content text not null
);

alter table motivation_letters enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved Portfolios
create table if not exists portfolios (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  content text not null,
  data jsonb
);

alter table portfolios enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own portfolios."
  on portfolios for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own portfolios."
  on portfolios for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- STORAGE SETUP
-- Run this to create the 'avatars' bucket and policies
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
values ('avatars', 'avatars', true)
on conflict (id) do nothing;

create policy "Avatar images are publicly accessible."
  on storage.objects for select
  using ( bucket_id = 'avatars' );

create policy "Authenticated users can upload avatars."
  on storage.objects for insert
  with check ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.role() = 'authenticated' );

create policy "Users can update their own avatars."
  on storage.objects for update
  using ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.uid() = owner )
  with check ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.uid() = owner );

-- ADMIN POLICIES (Run this block separately if tables already exist)
-- Allow admins to see everything
create policy "Admins can view all profiles" on profiles for select using ( (select is_admin from profiles where id = auth.uid()) = true );
create policy "Admins can view all interviews" on interviews for select using ( (select is_admin from profiles where id = auth.uid()) = true );
create policy "Admins can view all cvs" on cvs for select using ( (select is_admin from profiles where id = auth.uid()) = true );
create policy "Admins can view all portfolios" on portfolios for select using ( (select is_admin from profiles where id = auth.uid()) = true );
create policy "Admins can view all letters" on motivation_letters for select using ( (select is_admin from profiles where id = auth.uid()) = true );
```

5.  Paste the SQL into the editor and click **Run**.

## Admin Setup

To make yourself an admin, find your user ID in the `auth.users` table (or log in and check your profile ID in the URL or console) and run this SQL:

```sql
UPDATE profiles SET is_admin = true WHERE id = 'YOUR_USER_ID_HERE';
```

# prepareAI

**Powered by DevJs**

## About The Project

prepareAI is an advanced, interactive platform designed to help you ace your job interviews. Powered by Google's cutting-edge Gemini API, this application provides a realistic, real-time interview experience using your camera and microphone. Practice with a conversational AI that asks relevant questions, listens to your answers, and provides instant, actionable feedback to help you improve.

Whether you're a junior developer or a senior product manager, prepareAI offers a wide range of domains and difficulty levels to simulate the interviews you'll actually face.

## Key Features

- **Realistic AI Interviewer**: Engage in a natural, back-and-forth conversation with an AI powered by Google Gemini.
- **Multiple Domains & Levels**: Choose from a variety of career paths like Software Engineering, Product Management, UX Design, Data Science, and more, with questions tailored for junior, mid-level, and senior roles.
- **Customizable Interviewer Personas**: Choose the personality of your AI interviewer—from a friendly recruiter to a stern technical lead—to simulate different types of interview environments.
- **Live Transcription**: See a real-time transcript of the conversation, helping you review your answers.
- **Instant Feedback**: Receive constructive, turn-by-turn feedback on your responses during the interview.
- **Comprehensive Performance Report**: After the interview, receive a detailed report summarizing your strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable advice.
- **Suggested Learning Resources**: Get a curated list of articles and resources based on your performance to help you study effectively.
- **Practice Mode**: Warm up without the pressure of a final report. Just focus on the conversation.
- **Video Recording**: Opt-in to record your session to review your body language and delivery later.
- **CV Builder & Motivation Letter**: Create professional documents and save them to your profile.
- **Portfolio Builder**: Generate a professional single-page portfolio website using AI.
- **Admin Dashboard**: A secure panel for administrators to view system statistics and user activity.

## Database Setup (Required)

To use the profile, history, document saving, and admin features, you must set up the database tables in your Supabase project.

1.  Open your project in the **Supabase Dashboard**.
2.  Go to the **SQL Editor** (icon on the left sidebar).
3.  Click **New query**.
4.  Copy the SQL script below:

```sql
-- Create a table for public profiles
create table if not exists profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users not null primary key,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone,
  full_name text,
  pronouns text,
  avatar_url text,
  is_admin boolean default false,

  constraint full_name_length check (char_length(full_name) >= 3)
);

-- Set up Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table profiles enable row level security;

create policy "Public profiles are viewable by everyone."
  on profiles for select
  using ( true );

create policy "Users can insert their own profile."
  on profiles for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = id );

create policy "Users can update own profile."
  on profiles for update
  using ( auth.uid() = id );

-- HELPER FUNCTION FOR ADMIN CHECK (Prevents Infinite Recursion)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_admin()
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid()
    AND is_admin = true
  );
$$;

-- Create a table for interviews
create table if not exists interviews (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  transcription jsonb not null,
  feedback jsonb not null,
  report jsonb,
  resources jsonb
);

-- Set up RLS for interviews
alter table interviews enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own interviews."
  on interviews for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert their own interviews."
  on interviews for insert
  with check ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved CVs
create table if not exists cvs (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  content text not null, -- HTML content
  data jsonb -- Raw input data for future editing
);

alter table cvs enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own CVs."
  on cvs for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own CVs."
  on cvs for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved Motivation Letters
create table if not exists motivation_letters (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  job_title text,
  company text,
  content text not null
);

alter table motivation_letters enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own letters."
  on motivation_letters for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- Create a table for saved Portfolios
create table if not exists portfolios (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
  user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  title text not null,
  content text not null,
  data jsonb
);

alter table portfolios enable row level security;

create policy "Users can view their own portfolios."
  on portfolios for select
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

create policy "Users can insert/update/delete their own portfolios."
  on portfolios for all
  using ( auth.uid() = user_id );

-- STORAGE SETUP
-- Run this to create the 'avatars' bucket and policies
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
values ('avatars', 'avatars', true)
on conflict (id) do nothing;

create policy "Avatar images are publicly accessible."
  on storage.objects for select
  using ( bucket_id = 'avatars' );

create policy "Authenticated users can upload avatars."
  on storage.objects for insert
  with check ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.role() = 'authenticated' );

create policy "Users can update their own avatars."
  on storage.objects for update
  using ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.uid() = owner )
  with check ( bucket_id = 'avatars' and auth.uid() = owner );

-- ADMIN POLICIES (Run this block separately if tables already exist)
-- Allow admins to see everything using the secure is_admin() function
create policy "Admins can view all profiles" on profiles for select using ( is_admin() = true );
create policy "Admins can view all interviews" on interviews for select using ( is_admin() = true );
create policy "Admins can view all cvs" on cvs for select using ( is_admin() = true );
create policy "Admins can view all portfolios" on portfolios for select using ( is_admin() = true );
create policy "Admins can view all letters" on motivation_letters for select using ( is_admin() = true );
```

5.  Paste the SQL into the editor and click **Run**.

## Admin Setup

To make yourself an admin, find your user ID in the `auth.users` table (or log in and check your profile ID in the URL or console) and run this SQL:

```sql
UPDATE profiles SET is_admin = true WHERE id = 'YOUR_USER_ID_HERE';
```
